title: Stepper diagram
description: Boxes placed on the stepper's 5 × 9 grid, and the arrows between them.

label.description: What the diagram shows, read out by screen readers.

id.description: Unique name for the box, used in arrows and in the steps file.

label.description: Text in the box. Long labels wrap; \n forces a line break.

rowSpan.description: Number of rows the box covers. Default 1.

colSpan.description: Number of columns the box covers. Default 1.

id.description: Name used in the steps file. Default: "from->to", e.g. "customer->shop".

from.description: id of the box the arrow starts at.

to.description: id of the box the arrow points to.

dashed.description: Draw a dashed line, e.g. for an email or other indirect message.

offset.description: Shift the arrow sideways. One column is 100 units; use 8 and -8 for two arrows between the same boxes.

bend.description: Which way an L-shaped arrow leaves its box. Default "horizontal".

labelSide.description: Where the label goes: "above" (default) or "below" a horizontal arrow, "right" (default) or "left" of a vertical one.

id.description: Unique name for the badge, used in the steps file.

box.description: id of the box the badge is pinned to.

label.description: Short text in the badge, e.g. "✓ Paid".

position.description: Which corner of the box the badge sits on. Default "top-right".
